launcher.intro: Scans your load order for statics/blending/blend texture variants (e.g. a "statics" subfolder next to any texture) and patches matching meshes to alpha-blend instead of alpha-test, generating a dedicated output plugin with the derived texture sets.

meshBlacklist.label: Mesh Blacklist
meshBlacklist.help: Meshes matching a rule here are never patched. Wildcards (*) allowed, e.g. "*\glass\*". Right click to add/remove rows.

editorIdKeywords.label: EditorID Blacklist Keywords
editorIdKeywords.help: Records whose EditorID contains one of these words (case-insensitive) are skipped entirely - useful where alpha testing is intentional (e.g. "ice", "glass"). Right click to add/remove rows.

autoGenerateAllowlist.label: Auto-Generate Allowlist
autoGenerateAllowlist.help: Only these source diffuse textures (relative to Data, e.g. "textures\landscape\dirt01.dds") get a missing statics sibling synthesized automatically. Wildcards (*) allowed. Right click to add/remove rows.

missingGameLocation.title: Missing Game Location

missingMo2Instance.message: Please select your Mod Organizer 2 instance folder.
missingMo2Instance.title: Missing MO2 Instance

completion.message: Generation complete. Don't forget to enable AutoBlend's output plugin in your mod manager's plugin list if it isn't already active.
